/usr/share/etcd/generate-pki.sh

if [[ "$(hostname)" == "node-01" ]]; then
  scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no /etc/etcd/pki/ca{.crt,.key} node-02:/etc/etcd/pki/
  scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no /etc/etcd/pki/ca{.crt,.key} node-03:/etc/etcd/pki/
fi

/usr/share/etcd/configure.sh

# node-01 generates the CA
if [[ "$(hostname)" == "node-01" ]]; then exit 0; fi

test -f /etc/etcd/pki/ca.crt
test -f /etc/etcd/pki/ca.key
